description: This file contains a class Upgrade5 that performs database schema updates, data migration, and configuration adjustments as part of an upgrade process in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for modifying settings tables, serializing/deserializing config data, and preparing the system for the next upgrade step.

classes.name: Upgrade5
classes.description: A controller class responsible for executing system upgrade tasks, primarily database schema modifications and configuration updates during an OpenCart upgrade process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that performs database modifications, configuration updates, data migrations, and prepares the response with progress and next step link.
